title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode4 Stronger

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Let's see... The CD Shiho recommended should be...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is!
Thank goodness I found it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She said it should help me because their drummer's very good. I'll try listening to it while I practice, starting today.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(These are our CDs...!
And they're on display in a prime location...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll tell the others about this later...
Hey, did you listen to that song?

Yeah, it was so good!
Got any others that you recommend?
Yeah, wanna check out my playlist later?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate C
rows.Line: But I haven't been listening to much music lately because I'm spending so much time studying...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate C
rows.Line:
You act chummy with just about anyone.
Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh...
I couldn't help but hide from them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, have you two heard of this band? They're called Leo/need! I just discovered them recently and they're pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've heard of them!
Also, isn't Honami in this band?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate A
rows.Line:
She's in a band...?
And she's gone pro?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm afraid that they're going to say some really mean things about me again...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm curious as to what this song's like. I might give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate B
rows.Line: Still, it's hard to believe that Honami's in a band. I didn't think she was the type.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate C
rows.Line: I mean, does that matter? She's clearly doing her best.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate C
rows.Line: Also, I've already had a chance to listen to this song. I thought it was pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
It is a good song.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate B
rows.Line: Do you know who else is in Leo/need besides Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Former Classmate C
rows.Line: Pretty sure they're all Honami's childhood friends. Like Hoshino and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm afraid that they're going to say some really mean things about me again...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
My mind keeps jumping back to that moment.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I know I can't keep going on like this...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem more motivated than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not noticing you sooner...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way you were drumming sounded a little different.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
It seemed like you were trying very hard to sound energized, but you thrashed around quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll be happy to listen.
I am a senior you look up to, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was at the CD shop earlier and just happened to see my old classmates from junior high school.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
From junior high school?
Wasn't that when...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
I don't have too many fond memories from back then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I ended up hiding from them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, they saw our CDs and I overheard them talking about us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I became so worried that they would say some more awful things about me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that wasn't what happened at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I ran and hid because I didn't want to hear them talking about me behind my back again...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though it was partially my fault that we ended up arguing with each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I immediately jumped to the conclusion that they were going to say mean things about me. Even when I found out that wasn't the case, I wasn't able to go over and talk to them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that we're professional musicians, I know that we'll be faced with various challenges moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We may need to be even more courageous than when we stood up to Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As the leader of this band, it's my duty to learn how to pull us in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I want to become stronger...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I understand why you felt that you were weak in that moment, Honami...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I believe that you've become such a strong girl.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When we first met, Honami, you had so much on your mind and were very indecisive, remember?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know it's hard for you to get a good sense of this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you've gradually been getting stronger. You're much more decisive now, and have the courage to speak your mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I think you should just keep doing your best and not get too anxious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I feel a little bit better now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I could help a little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
This seems like a nice place to stop and get a change of scenery. Would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes!
A rather interesting place just appeared in SEKAI...
